scripts.build: pnpm --filter @executive-bi/operations build && pnpm --filter @executive-bi/ai build && tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @executive-bi/operations build && pnpm --filter @executive-bi/ai build && pnpm --filter @executive-bi/analytics build && pnpm --filter @executive-bi/investigations build && pnpm --filter @executive-bi/metrics build && pnpm --filter @executive-bi/retrieval build && pnpm --filter @executive-bi/schemas build && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @executive-bi/operations build && pnpm --filter @executive-bi/ai build && pnpm run check && tsc --project tsconfig.json && node --test test/*.test.mjs
